next:wr:133.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:133.hint: 彼は一日中文句を言っているだけだ
next:wr:133.answer: All he does is complain all day.
next:wr:133.fullSentence: All he does is complain all day.
next:wr:133.explanation: All S does is (to) do ~『Sは〜するだけだ』。
next:wr:133.relatedInfo: All S have to do is ~ と形が似ているが意味が異なる点に注意。

next:wr:135.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:135.hint: 今日は来てくれてありがとう
next:wr:135.explanation: 前置詞forの後は動名詞。Thanks for doing『〜してくれてありがとう』。
next:wr:135.relatedInfo: forの後に原形不定詞は続かない。

next:wr:137.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:137.hint: あなたがしばらく待つことは気にしません(意味上の主語が異なる)
next:wr:137.answer: I don't mind your waiting for a while.
next:wr:137.fullSentence: I don't mind your waiting for a while.
next:wr:137.explanation: 主文の主語と動名詞の意味上の主語が異なるとき、人は所有格か目的格を動名詞の前に置いて示す。
next:wr:137.relatedInfo: 物の場合は目的格のみ(例: I don't mind it raining.)。

next:wr:139.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:139.hint: 彼女は(今)看護師であることを(今)誇りに思っている
next:wr:139.answer: She is proud of being a nurse.
next:wr:139.fullSentence: She is proud of being a nurse.
next:wr:139.explanation: is proud of being『(今)〜であることを(今)誇りに思う』。動名詞の時制は述語動詞と同時。
next:wr:139.relatedInfo: She is proud of having been a nurse.(以前〜だったこと)との対比。

next:wr:141.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:141.hint: 彼女は(以前)看護師だったことを(今)誇りに思っている
next:wr:141.answer: She is proud of having been a nurse in the past.
next:wr:141.fullSentence: She is proud of having been a nurse in the past.
next:wr:141.explanation: is proud of having been『(今)〜だったこと(以前)を誇りに思う』。動名詞の完了形で述語動詞より前の時を表す。
next:wr:141.relatedInfo: She is proud of being a nurse.(同時)との対比。

next:wr:143.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:143.hint: 彼は人前で批判されることが好きではない
next:wr:143.answer: He doesn't like being criticized in public.
next:wr:143.fullSentence: He doesn't like being criticized in public.
next:wr:143.explanation: being V.pp『〜されること』。動名詞の受動態。
next:wr:143.relatedInfo: 不定詞のto be V.ppに対応する動名詞の形。

next:wr:145.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:145.hint: あなたにまた会えるのを楽しみに待っています
next:wr:145.answer: I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
next:wr:145.fullSentence: I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
next:wr:145.explanation: look forward to A/doing『〜することを楽しみに待つ』。toは前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。
next:wr:145.relatedInfo: to不定詞のtoと混同して原形にしないよう注意。

next:wr:147.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:147.hint: 彼は夜勤で働くことに慣れている
next:wr:147.answer: He is accustomed to working night shifts.
next:wr:147.fullSentence: He is accustomed to working night shifts.
next:wr:147.explanation: be accustomed to A/doing『〜することに慣れている』。be used toとほぼ同義でやや堅い表現。
next:wr:147.relatedInfo: get accustomed to A/doingは『〜することに慣れる(変化)』。

next:wr:149.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:149.hint: 多くの住民がその新しい建設計画に反対した
next:wr:149.answer: Many residents objected to the new construction plan.
next:wr:149.fullSentence: Many residents objected to the new construction plan.
next:wr:149.explanation: object to A/doing『〜するのに反対する』。toは前置詞。
next:wr:149.relatedInfo: 後ろに動名詞が来る場合もobject to doingの形になる。

next:wr:151.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:151.hint: 今夜夕食に出かけるのはいかがですか
next:wr:151.answer: What do you say to going out for dinner tonight?
next:wr:151.fullSentence: What do you say to going out for dinner tonight?
next:wr:151.explanation: What do you say to A/doing?『Aはいかがですか/〜しませんか』(提案)。

next:wr:153.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:153.hint: 彼女は暗闇の中で家までの道を見つけるのに苦労した
next:wr:153.answer: She had trouble finding her way home in the dark.
next:wr:153.fullSentence: She had trouble finding her way home in the dark.
next:wr:153.explanation: have trouble (in) doing『〜するのが難しい』。

next:wr:155.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:155.hint: 彼と言い争っても意味がない
next:wr:155.answer: There is no point arguing with him.
next:wr:155.fullSentence: There is no point arguing with him.
next:wr:155.explanation: There is no point (in) doing.『〜しても意味がない、無駄だ』。
next:wr:155.relatedInfo: It is no use doing.も同義。

next:wr:157.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:157.hint: 今それを心配して何になるのか(心配しても無駄だ)
next:wr:157.answer: What is the use of worrying about it now?
next:wr:157.fullSentence: What is the use of worrying about it now?
next:wr:157.explanation: What is the use of doing?『〜して何になるのか(〜しても無駄だ)』。

next:wr:159.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:159.hint: 彼が才能があることは言うまでもない
next:wr:159.answer: It goes without saying that he is talented.
next:wr:159.fullSentence: It goes without saying that he is talented.
next:wr:159.explanation: It goes without saying that ~『〜は言うまでもない』。
next:wr:159.relatedInfo: Needless to say, ~ とほぼ同義。

next:wr:161.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:161.hint: 家に着くとすぐに、彼女はシャワーを浴びた
next:wr:161.answer: On arriving home, she took a shower.
next:wr:161.fullSentence: On arriving home, she took a shower.
next:wr:161.explanation: on doing『〜するとすぐに、〜すると同時に』。
next:wr:161.relatedInfo: = As soon as she arrived home。

next:wr:163.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:163.hint: 彼女は貧しい人々を助けることに人生を捧げた
next:wr:163.answer: She devoted her life to helping the poor.
next:wr:163.fullSentence: She devoted her life to helping the poor.
next:wr:163.explanation: devote ... to A/doing『…をAに捧げる』。toは前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。

next:wr:165.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:165.hint: 彼女はみんなの夕食代を払うと言い張った
next:wr:165.answer: She insisted on paying for everyone's dinner.
next:wr:165.fullSentence: She insisted on paying for everyone's dinner.
next:wr:165.explanation: insist on A/doing『〜と言い張る、主張する』。
next:wr:165.relatedInfo: onは前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。

next:wr:167.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:167.hint: 彼女は彼を説得してクラブに入らせた
next:wr:167.answer: She talked him into joining the club.
next:wr:167.fullSentence: She talked him into joining the club.
next:wr:167.explanation: talk A into doing『説得して〜させる』。
next:wr:167.relatedInfo: talk A out of doing『説得して〜するのをやめさせる』も対で覚える。

next:wr:170.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:170.hint: 彼にはクリスと名付けられた息子がいる
next:wr:170.answer: He has a son named Chris.
next:wr:170.fullSentence: He has a son named Chris.
next:wr:170.explanation: 過去分詞の限定用法(後置修飾): 名付けられた(受動)の意味。
next:wr:170.relatedInfo: broken glass(名詞の前に置く過去分詞)も同じ限定用法。

next:wr:172.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:172.hint: 遠くの方で恐ろしい音が聞こえた
next:wr:172.answer: There was a frightening sound heard in the distance.
next:wr:172.fullSentence: There was a frightening sound heard in the distance.
next:wr:172.explanation: There is構文+過去分詞(受動の叙述用法)。音が『聞かれた』という受動の意味。
next:wr:172.relatedInfo: going by(能動・進行)との対比。

next:wr:174.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:174.hint: 彼は走って私たちのところに来た
next:wr:174.explanation: 付帯状況の現在分詞: 移動動詞+doing『〜しながら…する』。
next:wr:174.relatedInfo: comeの後に現在分詞を置いて様態を加える。

next:wr:176.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:176.hint: 私たちは彼女が劇場に入っていくのを見た
next:wr:176.answer: We saw her going into the theater.
next:wr:176.fullSentence: We saw her going into the theater.
next:wr:176.explanation: 知覚動詞see+O+doing『Oが〜しているのを見る』(進行中の動作)。
next:wr:176.relatedInfo: see+O+do(原形)なら最初から最後まで見た意味になる。

next:wr:178.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:178.hint: 私たちは彼がその歌を歌うのを聞いた(最初から最後まで)
next:wr:178.answer: We heard him sing that song.
next:wr:178.fullSentence: We heard him sing that song.
next:wr:178.explanation: 知覚動詞hear+O+do(原形)『Oが〜するのを(最初から最後まで)聞く』。
next:wr:178.relatedInfo: We heard him singing that song.(進行中、途中)との対比。

next:wr:180.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:180.hint: 私は(呼ばれている)自分の名前を聞いた
next:wr:180.explanation: 知覚動詞hear+O+過去分詞『Oが〜されるのを聞く』(受動の目的格補語)。
next:wr:180.relatedInfo: 目的語Oと分詞が受動関係のときは過去分詞を使う。

next:wr:182.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:182.hint: 私は寝ている間に自分の名前が呼ばれるのを聞いた
next:wr:182.answer: I heard my name called while I was sleeping.
next:wr:182.fullSentence: I heard my name called while I was sleeping.
next:wr:182.explanation: 知覚動詞+O+過去分詞に時を表す副詞節を加えた形。
next:wr:182.relatedInfo: while S was doingで動作の背景を示す。
